name: Round dub sub
desc: Round, patient sine sub in Ab minor for minimal and dub-leaning sets: syncopated placements that lean on the and-of-two, a fifth answer every fourth bar, mask exhales every 8th. No filter theatrics — just weight, shape-warmed and softly pumping. The pocket player that leaves all the mid-range for clicks and stabs.

code.full: note("<[ab1 ~ [~ ab1] ~] [ab1 ~ [~ ab1] [~ ab1]] [ab1 ~ [~ ab1] ~] [ab1 ~ [~ eb1] ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.01).decay(.32).sustain(.4).release(.15).shape(.45).lpf(340).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 1 [1 0]>").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[ab1 ~ [~ ab1] ab1] [ab1 ~ [~ ab1] [~ ab1]] [ab1 [~ ab1] [~ ab1] ~] [ab1 ~ [~ eb1] [gb1 ab1]]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.01).decay(.26).sustain(.38).release(.12).shape(.55).lpf(380).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.22)).orbit(3).play()
